title: Prefetch workers share one copy of the command's seeded repository facts
description: Prefetch workers share one copy of the command's seeded repository facts
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-git-utils-011 lets prefetch workers start from what the command already knows; each worker deep-copied every memoized Git output, so a large memoized result was copied once per worker. The seed now shares one copy; output is unchanged (#955)
acceptance_criteria: a repository-fact seed cloned for each prefetch worker shares one copy of the command's facts, a worker's scope still answers from them, and facts the worker learns stay its own; output is unchanged
